name: Amplitude
description: Amplitude is a digital analytics platform for Events, users, sessions, charts, dashboards, Funnels, Retention, Cohorts, experiments, feature flags, and product insights.
agentUseSummary: Enter one Analytics Project API/Secret Key pair and allowlisted default or EU Dashboard REST origin. Relay validates the project-bound pair while discarding visible Event data, then exposes only unsegmented daily active/new-user counts and average session length over explicit ranges of at most 31 days; users, identity, event names/properties, raw events, detailed reports, broader APIs, arbitrary queries, exports, and writes remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: AMPLITUDE_DASHBOARD_REST_ORIGIN
credentialRequirements.label: Amplitude data region
credentialRequirements.helpText: Choose Standard unless the Amplitude project uses EU data residency. Relay sends Dashboard REST requests only to the selected official Amplitude region.

credentialRequirements.name: AMPLITUDE_PROJECT_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Amplitude Project API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the API key for the exact Analytics Project, including the project API key shown during onboarding. Do not use a Data, Experiment, Management, or organization token.

credentialRequirements.name: AMPLITUDE_PROJECT_SECRET_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Amplitude Project Secret key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate the matching Secret Key in Amplitude under Settings > Projects > your project > General. Amplitude shows it only when generated; Relay needs it to read analytics through the Dashboard REST API.

capabilities.label: Project binding
capabilities.description: Validate one exact Project API/Secret Key pair and Dashboard REST region.

allowed.label: Read Project-key binding
allowed.description: Validate the exact Dashboard REST origin and Project API/Secret Key pair while discarding visible Event data.

allowed.label: Read daily active or new users
allowed.description: Read one unsegmented daily active/new-user aggregate series over an explicit range of at most 31 days.

allowed.label: Read average session length
allowed.description: Read one unsegmented daily average-session-length series over an explicit range of at most 31 days.

blocked.label: Access users or identity
blocked.description: User profiles, identifiers, properties, session replay, cohorts and membership, classified data, and person-level activity are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access events or detailed reports
blocked.description: Event names/properties, raw events, charts, dashboards, funnels, retention, segmentation, breakdowns, annotations, and raw exports are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change Amplitude data
blocked.description: Ingesting events, managing charts/cohorts/annotations, experiments, flags, data, users, keys, or any other mutation is outside V1.

blocked.label: Access broader Amplitude APIs
blocked.description: Data, Experiment, Management, ingestion, Profile, Privacy, SCIM, cohort-download, and organization APIs are outside V1.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary requests
blocked.description: Arbitrary origins, paths, events, properties, segments, groups, formulas, charts, date ranges beyond 31 days, crawling, synchronization, and raw API access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Three bounded aggregate/binding reads run automatically; users, identity, events, detailed reports, broader APIs, arbitrary queries, exports, and writes stay blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same three read-only tools run while exact regional-origin and Project-key binding, fixed unsegmented queries, short date ranges, audit, redaction, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts three bounded Amplitude aggregate wrappers and attaches the encrypted Project key pair and validated Dashboard REST origin server-side.
Railway mounts three bounded Amplitude aggregate wrappers and attaches the encrypted Project key pair and validated Dashboard REST origin server-side.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer generates an Analytics Project API/Secret Key pair for the exact Project, records the one-time Secret Key, supplies the correct default/EU Dashboard REST origin, and rotates or revokes the key pair in Project settings.

evidence.supports: Amplitude documents Project API Keys as project identifiers and Secret Keys as server-side authentication for APIs that read or modify Project data, with rotation/revocation support.
Amplitude documents locating the exact Project API/Secret Keys and authenticating server-side Analytics API requests.

Amplitude documents exact default/EU Dashboard REST origins, Basic authentication, Project rate limits, active/new-user and average-session endpoints, their date parameters, and aggregate response schemas.
Amplitude documents separate ingestion hosts and APIs; Relay does not accept ingestion credentials or expose ingestion operations.
